changeSet.author: hephaestus

preConditions.onFailMessage: Native provider IDs could not be resolved without data loss. No rows were changed. Keep every monitor and project stop. Follow the native-provider-ids migration entry to report and repair unresolved rows, then retry.

changeSet.sql:
DO $native_ids$ DECLARE issues jsonb; BEGIN WITH monitor_ids AS ( SELECT m.id, m.workspace_id, m.name_with_owner AS selection, COALESCE(m.native_id, ( SELECT min(r.native_id) FROM repository r JOIN identity_provider p ON p.id = r.provider_id JOIN connection c ON c.workspace_id = m.workspace_id AND c.kind = p.type AND c.config->>'serverUrl' = p.server_url AND c.state IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED') WHERE lower(r.name_with_owner) = lower(m.name_with_owner) AND r.native_id > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item i WHERE i.workspace_id = m.workspace_id AND i.kind = 'scm.repository' AND i.parent_id IS NULL AND i.source_id = r.id) HAVING count(DISTINCT r.native_id) = 1 )) AS native_id FROM repository_to_monitor m ), group_ids AS ( SELECT c.id, c.workspace_id, w.account_login AS selection, c.config->'gitlabGroupId' AS stored_id, (SELECT o.native_id FROM organization o JOIN identity_provider p ON p.id = o.provider_id WHERE o.id = w.organization_id AND o.native_id > 0 AND p.type = c.kind AND p.server_url = c.config->>'serverUrl') AS resolved_id FROM connection c JOIN workspace w ON w.id = c.workspace_id WHERE c.kind = 'GITLAB' ), problems AS ( SELECT 'monitor' AS kind, m.id AS row_id, m.workspace_id, m.selection, 'No positive provider ID with workspace-owned evidence' AS reason FROM monitor_ids m WHERE m.native_id IS NULL OR m.native_id <= 0 UNION ALL SELECT 'monitor', m.id, m.workspace_id, m.selection, 'Duplicate provider ID in this workspace' FROM monitor_ids m WHERE m.native_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM monitor_ids other WHERE other.workspace_id = m.workspace_id AND other.native_id = m.native_id AND other.id <> m.id) UNION ALL SELECT 'group', g.id, g.workspace_id, g.selection, 'No positive provider group ID with workspace-owned evidence' FROM group_ids g WHERE CASE WHEN g.stored_id IS NULL OR g.stored_id = 'null'::jsonb THEN g.resolved_id IS NULL WHEN jsonb_typeof(g.stored_id) = 'number' AND g.stored_id::text ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' THEN g.stored_id::text::numeric > 9223372036854775807 ELSE true END UNION ALL SELECT 'stop', c.id, c.workspace_id, path.value, 'No positive provider ID with workspace-owned evidence' FROM connection c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text( COALESCE(c.config#>'{projectExclusions,unresolvedPaths}', '[]')) path(value) WHERE c.kind = 'GITLAB' AND ( SELECT count(DISTINCT r.native_id) FROM repository r JOIN identity_provider p ON p.id = r.provider_id WHERE p.type = c.kind AND p.server_url = c.config->>'serverUrl' AND lower(r.name_with_owner) = lower(path.value) AND r.native_id > 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM item i WHERE i.workspace_id = c.workspace_id AND i.kind = 'scm.repository' AND i.parent_id IS NULL AND i.source_id = r.id) ) <> 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'stop-id', c.id, c.workspace_id, value::text, 'Project stop ID must be a positive JSON integer' FROM connection c CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements( COALESCE(c.config#>'{projectExclusions,nativeIds}', '[]')) ids(value) WHERE c.kind = 'GITLAB' AND CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) = 'number' AND value::text ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' THEN value::text::numeric > 9223372036854775807 ELSE true END ) SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object( 'kind', kind, 'row_id', row_id, 'workspace_id', workspace_id, 'selection', selection, 'reason', reason, 'workspace_retained_items', (SELECT count(*) FROM item i WHERE i.workspace_id = problems.workspace_id), 'unresolved_repository_items', (SELECT count(*) FROM item i WHERE i.workspace_id = problems.workspace_id AND i.kind = 'scm.repository' AND i.parent_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM repository r WHERE r.id = i.source_id))) ORDER BY kind, row_id, selection), '[]') INTO issues FROM problems;
IF issues <> '[]'::jsonb THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Native provider IDs could not be resolved without data loss. No rows were changed. Rows: %. Follow https://github.com/hephaestus-build/Hephaestus/blob/main/MIGRATION.md#-stop-every-role-before-requiring-native-provider-ids', issues; END IF; END; $native_ids$;
changeSet.comment: Bind legacy path selections to provider identities owned by their workspace on the connection origin. Unresolvable or duplicate selections refuse before any write. Retained work and stop receipts stay unchanged.

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade backup to recover path-only selections and their original IDs.
